comparison.objective: Serve one meatball without utensil cross-contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Choose the clean scoop, physically support and lift the meatball, then release it on a plate.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one meatball must be delivered with the clean utensil and no propagated contamination or spill.
comparison.reason: The record tests utensil selection, scooping, and contact-history hygiene, not flush rail mating or containment of recirculating elements.
